facts: Alexander the Great is said to have founded and named a city Peritas, in memory of his dog.
In early Christian tradition, Saint Christopher, the patron saint of travelers, is sometimes depicted with a dog’s head.
An American Animal Hospital Association poll found that 33% of dog owners admit to talking to their dogs on the phone and leaving answering machine messages for them while away.
Dogs can hear sounds at a frequency of up to 45,000 Hz, while humans can only hear up to 20,000 Hz.
A dog's nose is made up of about 220 million scent receptors, while a human's nose has about 5 million.
